Netflix, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json. The colours, type, radii and spacing were read from the public signed-out pages at netflix.com/sg and netflix.com/sg/login on 2026-11-19. The pages ship one dark theme. Screenshots were not saved: the preview browser returned no screenshot frames.

Netflix Sans is Netflix's own face and is not loaded here. The stack falls back to Helvetica Neue, Segoe UI, Roboto, Ubuntu, sans-serif.

Colour

The dark set names the page, the field surface, the red action, text, and borders. Core holds the same colours as measured values. There is no light set.

Palette

The measured colours, one swatch each. Netflix does not publish a multi-step ramp on these pages.

Typography

One family, Netflix Sans, with Helvetica Neue, Segoe UI, Roboto and Ubuntu behind it. Sizes are the computed values at a 1169 CSS-pixel viewport.

Families

font.family.netflix-sansfallback stack, Netflix Sans is not loaded
Unlimited films, series and more

Density, space and shape

Spacing steps are lengths read on the page: 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 64, 80 and 96. Radius steps are the button, the trending tile, the value card, the footer link, and the square FAQ row.

Radius

Elevation

The measured controls had box-shadow none. Elevation on these pages is the field border and the focus ring, not a drop shadow.

Motion

Buttons and the FAQ headline declare 250 ms. Pressed duration is 0. Hover easing is a different cubic-bezier from the resting one. Click a track to play it.

Layout

At 1169 CSS pixels the header is 80 px tall and the content column starts 80 px from the left. The hero is 760 px tall. The login form column is 440 px wide.

Components

Specimens use the measured tokens. Hover and pressed colours are the declared Hawkins values. Focus is the white ring. Disabled, error, success and warning were declared on the input and were not shown on the page.
